residual_risks: The operations policy, hold registry, quota serialization, audit store and backup custodian of the qualifying cases are test adapters on the real PostgreSQL and OpenBao; no production authority service exists yet (open, unassigned).

The final control check and the effects at the independent lifecycle, audit and store authorities are not one transaction; a store commit failure after admission can leave a PENDING version handled by the existing reconciliation (open, tracked toward FGM-17; not claimed closed).
The restore checkpoint port must be the same trusted deletion authority composed into the DeletionRestoreGate; the composition is a deployment obligation, not enforced by type.

Quotas count committed logical heads and native representation slots, not historical journal or object bytes; process-local serialization would not qualify cross-worker use (only the shared PostgreSQL adapter is qualified).
Manifest and audit digests are non-content references that may be correlatable; the membership-inference risk declared in 0055 remains open and unassigned.

Inventory comparison is optimistic across independent metadata/ledger authorities: a write after the final inventory read is not atomically excluded for monitoring/capture; restore revalidates before serving. Stop-check/delivery is likewise non-atomic; FGM-17 remains open.
